metadata.title: Vibrant Sun-Drenched Portrait with Primary Color Blocking

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait featuring a subject in a textured headwrap against a bold, color-blocked architectural background in primary tones.
triggerTerms: natural light beauty shot with blue background
excludeWhen: muted or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, three-quarter profile portrait of a woman with braided hair wearing a voluminous, textured yellow and orange headwrap. The scene is illuminated by harsh, direct sunlight creating sharp shadows and highlights on the skin. The background consists of vertical architectural elements in saturated blue and yellow, creating a strong color-blocked composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow headwrap creates a monochromatic harmony with the yellow background panel.
The saturated blue background provides a high-contrast complementary backdrop to the warm skin tones and yellow fabric.
The diagonal line of the braided hair balances the vertical lines of the background architecture.
coreInvariants: Direct, high-angle sunlight with defined facial shadows
Saturated primary color palette (Yellow and Blue)
Textured fabric headwrap as a central focal point
Three-quarter facial orientation looking away from the lens

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is positioned in the left-center of the frame, captured in a medium close-up scale from the shoulders up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary anchor, emphasized by the sharp light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the curve of the headwrap down to the face, then follows the subject's gaze toward the left, finally resting on the texture of the braids.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, filled with saturated color panels that frame the subject tightly.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow (headwrap and background panel) providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cerulean Blue (background) providing a cool, structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Black (braids and eyelashes) providing grounding points of high density.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all channels with high value contrast between sunlit skin and deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain pure primary yellow and blue tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution portrait of a woman with glowing skin and braids, wearing a textured orange-yellow headwrap. Place her against a background of vertical blue and yellow wooden or metal panels. Use direct, bright sunlight to create sharp highlights on the cheekbones and nose.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, clean sans-serif font in white or black, positioned in the negative space of the blue panel to maintain the color-block aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the sunlight direct and creating sharp shadows?
Are the blue and yellow colors highly saturated?
Is the headwrap texture clearly visible?
Is the subject in a three-quarter profile?

mustRedesign: Ensure the headwrap does not blend into the background yellow

mustAchieve: Realistic skin texture under harsh light

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleeding between the yellow fabric and yellow background.
Ensure the braid texture is distinct and not a solid black mass.
Verify the catchlight in the eyes from the natural sun.
Confirm the verticality of the background elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + [Subject Attribute: Headwrap/Braids] + [Lighting: Direct Sunlight/High Contrast] + [Background: Primary Color Blocking] + [Composition: Three-Quarter Profile]
